result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: transition assistance for up to six months at then-current rates, return within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and subsequent deletion certification. Existing payment, termination, and work-product provisions remain substantively unchanged. However, the amendment is broader than necessary because it extends the return and deletion obligations beyond Company Data to all Company materials and Confidential Information, some of which may not be capable of return in machine-readable form.
